links.outcome: Consistency of chatbot answers to the same exam questions across two rounds one month apart
links.effect: No significant accuracy difference between Day-0 and Month-1 for any chatbot, but GPT-4o was inconsistent: 19 questions correct in round one were incorrect in round two.
links.quote: The performance of GPT-4o was the most inconsistent, as 19 questions answered correctly in the first round were answered incorrectly in the second round.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance and reliability over time of four AI chatbots (ChatGPT-4o mini, ChatGPT-4o, Gemini Advance, CoPilot Pro) on periodontology exam questions in dental education without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
